T-001.Title: Bind /ext/context and /ext/apply to the document instance on the server: record the context binding, require it on apply, refuse missing (400) and stale (409) before any mt::text::op

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: In src-tauri/src/m045_ext/live_server.rs START_BLOCK_REQUEST_TYPES add pub struct DocumentBinding { pub document_id: Option<String>, pub document_generation: Option<String> } (Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq) next to the E1a ext types; extend ExtContextResponse with pub document_id: Option<String> and pub document_generation: Option<String> (serde deserializes the absent field as None, so an older renderer callback payload stays valid and yields a binding that can never match) and extend ExtApplyRequest with the same two Option<String> fields — the fields are mandatory by policy, enforced in the handler (criterion below), not by serde, so the omission rejection is a distinct logged 400; next to the existing static CONTEXT_REQUEST_COUNTER add the process-global static EXT_DOCUMENT_BINDINGS: std::sync::Mutex<HashMap<String, DocumentBinding>> keyed by extension_id — deliberately not a LiveServerState field, so the LiveServerState struct literal in src-tauri/src/main.rs (line 799) stays untouched and main.rs remains outside the write scope.

handle_ext_context keeps authenticate_incoming(..., Some(&req.extension_id), Some(RouteCapability::ContextRead)) first (the capability gate still runs first), keeps the request-id minting, live_bridge emit, 5s timeout and every cleanup arm unchanged, and in the success arm (Ok(Ok(context))) records EXT_DOCUMENT_BINDINGS.insert(req.extension_id.clone(), DocumentBinding { document_id: context.document_id.clone(), document_generation: context.document_generation.clone() }) before answering 200 — recording also a (None, None) binding when the renderer reported no rendered identity, which refuses every apply for that extension until a later context read carries identity; a timed-out or channel-closed request records nothing.

handle_ext_apply keeps authenticate_incoming(..., Some(&req.extension_id), Some(RouteCapability::TextEdit)) first; after authentication and before the operation loop it enforces the binding fence: when req.document_id or req.document_generation is None it logs BLOCK_EXT_APPLY_MISSING_BINDING and answers 400 BAD_REQUEST with Json({"error": "missing document binding: document_id and document_generation are required"}); otherwise it loads the remembered binding for req.extension_id and, when there is no remembered binding, the remembered binding has a None field, or any field differs, it logs BLOCK_EXT_APPLY_BINDING_MISMATCH and answers 409 CONFLICT with Json({"error": "document binding mismatch; re-read context"}); both rejections happen before any mt::text::op event is emitted and never produce an ExtApplyResponse with applied: true; the success path is otherwise byte-identical (same op_type mapping, same payloads plus the binding, same ExtApplyResponse { applied: true, operations_count }).

In the operation loop the emitted payload objects gain the binding so it travels to the editor inside the existing TextOpEvent payload object: "document_id": req.document_id.clone() and "document_generation": req.document_generation.clone() are added to the transform payload, the insert_at_cursor payload (alongside text and position) and the undo payload (previously {}); text_ops.rs, the /ext/text-insert route, handle_text_insert and all auth/pairing/stream code stay byte-identical.

Module hygiene: live_server.rs CHANGE_SUMMARY gains a dated 2026-11-20 C-SEC-EDIT-TARGETING entry and the SCOPE line names the document-bound context/apply round trip; every START_BLOCK_/END_BLOCK_ marker stays paired and unique; the existing log anchors (BLOCK_EXT_CONTEXT_*, BLOCK_EXT_APPLY apart from the two new markers, BLOCK_AUTH_FAILED_INCOMING) are unchanged; no Cargo.toml, dependency, main.rs, text_ops.rs, registry or renderer change in this task.

T-002.Title: Thread the binding through the renderer: textOps relays documentId/documentGeneration, the editor rejects mismatch before any mutation including the setMarkdown fallback, and the context response names the rendered instance

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: In src/renderer/src/components/extensionGallery/textOps.js handleTextOp passes the whole wire payload to the undo branch (handleUndo(payload, extId)); handleInsert, handleTransform and handleUndo forward the binding onto their bus payloads — documentId: payload.document_id and documentGeneration: payload.document_generation are added to the ext-text-insert, ext-text-transform and ext-undo emit objects next to the existing text/position/extensionId fields — so a wire payload without binding fields forwards undefined (textOps stays a pure relay; rejection is editor-side); handleContextRequest is unchanged; the module contract CHANGE_SUMMARY gains the dated entry and the SCOPE line names the binding relay.

In src/renderer/src/components/editorWithTabs/editor.vue START_BLOCK_EXT_TEXT_OPS add the helper extBindingMatchesRendered({ documentId, documentGeneration }) returning !!renderedTabId && !!renderedDocumentOwner && renderedTabId === documentId && renderedDocumentOwner.documentToken === documentGeneration, built on the existing rendered-identity locals that are set only on successful render; handleExtTextInsert, handleExtTextTransform and handleExtUndo destructure the two new fields and their FIRST statement is the guard — when extBindingMatchesRendered returns false (mismatched, stale, null or absent binding, including undefined from unbound events such as /ext/text-insert or the text_ops.rs commands) the handler logs the content-free marker console.warn('[Editor][BLOCK_EXT_TARGETING_MISMATCH op=insert|transform|undo]') and returns before routeSource, before any mutation — editor.value.insertParagraph, editor.value.replace, and the whole-document editor.value.setMarkdown(text) fallback included — and before the try/catch success logs; the diffGuarded wrapper, its guardDiff ordering (diff/read-only still drops first) and the bus wiring bytes (ext-text-insert/ext-text-transform/ext-undo through diffGuarded, ext-context-request unguarded) are unchanged.

handleExtContextRequest keeps flushSplit and its markdown/cursor/selection/file_path gathering and derives the binding from the rendered identity: document_id = renderedTabId when renderedTabId && renderedDocumentOwner && renderedTabId === currentFile.value?.id, else null; document_generation = documentId ? renderedDocumentOwner.documentToken : null; the emitted context object becomes context: { markdown, cursor, selection, file_path: filePath, document_id: documentId, document_generation: documentGeneration } — absent identity is represented explicitly as nulls and can never match an apply; the editor.vue CHANGE_SUMMARY/MODULE_MAP gain the dated entry naming extBindingMatchesRendered and the binding fields.

T-003.Title: Prove the fence: Rust binding matrix with red-first flip, renderer passthrough and editor-targeting regressions, graph and verification deltas

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: In src-tauri/src/m045_ext/tests.rs update the IncomingFixture context responder (lines 967-976) to answer each mt::ext::context_request with ExtContextResponse carrying document_id: Some(format!("tab-{}", f.id)) and document_generation: Some(format!("document-gen-{}", n)) where n is a fixture-local counter incremented per request — each context round trip hands a fresh generation, modeling an instance replacement — and record the last handed pair on the fixture for assertions; update the ExtApplyRequest literal in apply_fixture (lines 1129-1135) to carry explicit binding arguments. Add the binding matrix in START_BLOCK_INCOMING_DATA_TESTS: context_response_carries_document_binding (parse the 200 body: document_id == tab-{id}, first call document-gen-1, second call document-gen-2), apply_requires_binding_fields (context then apply with document_id None → 400 with zero mt::text::op events; the generation-None variant likewise), apply_requires_matching_context_binding (fresh fixture: apply before any context → 409 with zero events; after context, apply with the exact handed pair → 200 with exactly one insert event whose payload.document_id and payload.document_generation equal the binding), and apply_stale_instance_binding_refused (context hands gen-1, matching apply 200; a second context hands gen-2, after which the gen-1 apply answers 409 with zero events and an apply naming a wrong document_id answers 409, while the gen-2 apply answers 200).

Reconcile the C-SEC-STREAM-SCOPE family with the fence without weakening any security expectation: apply_requires_text_edit_capability moves its happy path to a dual-capability fixture (context.read and text.edit registered together) that performs the context read before the successful apply, while a text.edit-only fixture now expects apply → 409 CONFLICT (capability passed, binding fence refused) with zero events; enabled_extension_passes_only_declared_capability_routes and fresh_pairing_restores_access reconcile the same way (a dual-capability fixture wherever an apply 200 is expected, single-capability refusals updated to the fence statuses); assert_old_token_fenced keeps 401/401/401 unchanged because authentication still precedes the binding fence; the stream security family, disable family, pairing/rebind family and text_insert_* family keep their expectations; no existing expectation is deleted or weakened.

Renderer regressions: tests/renderer/components/textOps.test.js and tests/renderer/components/extensionGallery/textOps.test.js gain binding-passthrough cases — a wire payload carrying document_id/document_generation forwards documentId/documentGeneration onto the ext-text-insert/ext-text-transform/ext-undo bus objects (assert the exact emit object), and a wire payload without them forwards undefined documentId/documentGeneration (the existing exact-match expectations stay valid because undefined keys compare equal to absent keys, and the extended cases state the undefined fields explicitly); tests/renderer/components/editor-coverage.test.js gains an editor_ext_targeting describe that invokes the captured bus handlers directly on a normally rendered document: ext-text-transform with a foreign documentId/documentGeneration calls neither mockEditorInstance.setMarkdown nor replace nor insertParagraph and logs BLOCK_EXT_TARGETING_MISMATCH, ext-text-insert with a stale generation inserts nothing, ext-undo with no binding undoes nothing; the matched-passthrough cases read the real rendered identity from the store tab (currentFile.id plus documentOwner(tab).documentToken through the real util) and prove transform applies exactly once (selection branch via replace, no-selection branch via the setMarkdown fallback), insert inserts and undo undoes; a diff-mode case proves the diff guard still drops events before the binding check.
